rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the hospitality a host provides, including treating guests to food, drink, or entertainment.

example.english: Thank you for your warm hospitality and for arranging so many activities.
example.traditional: 多謝你咁熱情款待我哋，仲安排埋咁多節目。
example.jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5 gam3 jit6 cing4 fun2 doi6 ngo5 dei6 zung6 on1 paai4 maai4 gam3 do1 zit3 muk6

rows.note: Use this casual rendering for the welcoming and looking-after-guests aspect of hospitality, especially in phrases such as thanking someone for their care.

example.english: Thank you for your wonderful hospitality these past few days; we had a great time.
example.traditional: 多謝你呢幾日咁好招呼，我哋玩得好開心。
example.jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5 ne1 gei2 jat6 gam3 hou2 ziu1 fu1 ngo5 dei6 waan2 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1

rows.jyutping: zau2 dim3 kap6 caan1 jam2 jip6
rows.note: Use this specifically for the hospitality industry covering hotels, restaurants, and related services.

example.english: After graduating, they want to work in the hospitality industry.
example.traditional: 佢畢業之後想投身酒店及餐飲業。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 soeng2 tau4 san1 zau2 dim3 kap6 caan1 jam2 jip6
